prompt: What is the median of the data set $3$, $7$, $1$, $9$, $5$?
hint: Sort the values before doing anything else.

hints.text: Sort the values before doing anything else.

learningObjective: Find the median of an unsorted data set.
explanation: With five values, the median is the third one.

alternativeExplanations.title: Sorting is not optional
steps: Taking the middle of the unsorted list gives $1$ — the most common error on median questions.
The median is defined by *position after sorting*, not by position as listed.
Write the sorted list on scratch paper; do not try to sort in your head.
